sequence.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production hand-painted2D tactical RPG animation atlas matching supplied character EXACTLY. Young adult human knight, short tousled chestnut hair, clear clean-shaven face, engraved steel and bronze armor, dark navy split tabard with restrained gold hem, brown gloves and proportional brown boots. One long rigid straight two-handed sword. BOTH hands around the SAME hilt in forward combat guard with diagonal upward blade, hands projected in front of chest; NEVER beside shoulder in a side guard. Camera: orthographic shallow18-degree elevation, DIRECT FRONT, facing viewer, face and chest visible symmetrically; NOT3/4, same facing in ALL44cells. Maintain functional anatomical handedness; do not mirror weapon hands. Detailed painted brushwork/crisp material edges, warm muted light. Proportional anatomy, gloves, modest sensible boots. True clean transparency, no floor/shadow/text/labels/fringe. Large tall output2048x3840. EXACT4 COLUMNS x11 ROWS,44 separate fully visible figures, generous cell margins including weapons and lying body. SAME body size/head size in every row.
ROW1 four NEUTRAL IDLE breathing poses with relaxed upright straight legs, weapon safely lowered.
ROW2 four COMBAT IDLE breathing poses, weapon prepared forward at chest height.
ROWS3-4 EIGHT-frame natural NEUTRAL WALK loop, alternate left/right heel contact, loading, toe off, passing foot, normal modest stride, credible knee flexion.
ROWS5-6 EIGHT-frame natural COMBAT WALK loop, keep weapon in raised ready guard while feet alternate; never revert to weapon dangling at thigh.
ROWS7-8 EIGHT-frame ATTACK: one full-body2-handed diagonal cut: guard, hip/torso coil, shoulder backswing, weight shift into beginning downswing, rigid blade cuts through, full follow-through, recover, original forward guard. Both gloved hands stay together on hilt.
ROW9 FOUR HIT frames: shoulder struck, recoil, stabilize feet, return guard.
ROWS10-11 EIGHT DEATH/FALL frames: struck, torso buckles, knees bend, knee ground, hand floor, body falls onto side, lands, final full body lying still. No gore. Articulated fall not rigid upright rotation. Fixed camera and facing, full silhouettes. Rows are chronological left to right; no omitted cells. Every sword/shaft remains straight and SAME physical length.
